entries.text: Oh, hey. So we meet again![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_01

entries.text: You remember me, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_02

entries.text: Oh, from the lighthouse!
entries.label: legend_0010_select_01

entries.text: I don’t think we’ve met...
entries.label: legend_0010_select_02

entries.text: Yeah, exactly! That’s my little know-it-all buddy!\nGot a mind like a steel trap, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_02a

entries.text: What?! Come on, I gave you [VAR 0x0101(0001)]’s\nPoké Ball! Did I forget to introduce myself...?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_02b

entries.text: Well, the name’s Arven.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]No need to tell me your name.\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)], right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_04

entries.text: Whole school seems to be talking about you.\c\nThe new kid who showed up with the president\nof the student council.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_05

entries.text: I normally wouldn’t even bother showing up for\nclass, but I came all the way to school today\r\njust to talk with you—our new celebrity.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_06

entries.text: You’ve gotta help me out so I can finally make\nmy dream a reality![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_07

entries.text: Happy to help!
entries.label: legend_0010_select_03

entries.text: What’s this dream, first?
entries.label: legend_0010_select_04

entries.text: What kind of little maniac says yes to something\nwithout even knowing what they’re agreeing to?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_08

entries.text: Hehehe... Caught your interest, have I? You want\nto hear all about my dream, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_09

entries.text:
Well, this might come as a surprise, but fact is,
I’m all about that picnic life: the great outdoors,
the perfectly prepared sandwiches, all of it.\c
Not half bad at cooking either, I can tell you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_10

entries.text: Right now I’m researching new recipes that’ll help\nPokémon feel better. Real health food, see.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_11

entries.text: I found this book the other day, and it had a\nsection about these Herba Mystica things...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_12

entries.text: Basically, they’re some kind of special herbs that\nheal up any Pokémon as soon as it eats them![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_13

entries.text:
Now, there are a total of five different types of
Herba Mystica, based on what I read.\c
Just taking a little lick of them once they’ve been
powdered will get your blood flowing, provide
nutrients, prevent aging—it’ll even boost the
immune system![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_14

entries.text: These herbs seem like they’re the real deal.\nOnly found here in Paldea—and rare to boot![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_15

entries.text: But this book says they’re all guarded by Titan\nPokémon, meaning that it’s gonna be pretty\r\ntough to try to grab even a few sprigs.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_16

entries.text: ’Cause, see, Titans are— Well, I think they’ve\ngotta be...things like this![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_24

entries.text: I really want to get those herbs for myself, but...\nI’m not very good at Pokémon battles.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_17

entries.text:
Don’t have any friends with strong Pokémon to
lend me a hand, either...\c
And I’d never hear the end of it if I went crawling
to that student council girl...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_18

entries.text: But here you waltz up! You’ve got to help me out\nwith this—you’d be perfect![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_19

entries.text: Nope! Wait! I don’t need an answer yet![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_20

entries.text: I’ll just register the places where it seems there\nmight be Titans in your map app for you.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_23

entries.text: Let it stew a bit, and we can get more into the\ndetails later. And in the meantime...take this.\r\nA little gift for listening and all.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_21

entries.text: Give the idea some serious thought! Please![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: legend_0010_friend_22
